always: One hero fills roughly 60-85% of the square card, centered or slightly off-center, with the background fully hidden behind it, never cropped by it.
The backdrop is a smooth saturated gradient or soft pattern in a color that contrasts with the hero (blue ticket on orange, blue pillow on pink, yellow fins on purple, red booth on green).
Backdrop shapes are very large and low-contrast: vertical stripes, concentric rings, a swirl, faint tone-on-tone suitcase icons, a plain wall and floor split.
Where there is a ground it is a simple plane (sand, cream floor, wood planks, stone paving) with a soft contact shadow under the hero.
Backdrop edge detail is low everywhere, apart from the few environment cards; the grey-out shows the background as calm, continuous fields.
Props, when present, are few and tied to the object: watering can and trowel on the planter shelf, bookmarks on the book, cocktails and fruit on the bar.
varies: Staging ranges from floating on a flat field (ticket, pillow, fins) to a ledge or floor with shadow (booth, carousel, sneakers) to a real material (wood table, planks) to a real scene (palm on dunes, garden with fence, desert gas pump).

Environment load rises in the scenes: a garden fence with bushes and paving, a pool bar with a thatch roof, tiled water and stools, and desert mesas are busier, with many small repeated shapes (fence slats, thatch shingles, pool tile).
Backdrop pattern type changes card to card: stripes, rings, spiral, icon repeat, wood grain, blue wall boards.
Background palette is mostly warm or saturated, with sky gradients on the scene cards. Horizon height varies from none to a mid-card split.

Hero and background are sometimes similar in hue (red booth on green is complementary; red gloves on blue wall with orange wood is complementary) and sometimes analogous in warmth (orange pump against a sunset desert).
never: Faces, eyes, sparkles, confetti, stars or invented whimsy decorations.
Text, logos or captions in the backdrop.
A cluttered or high-contrast backdrop pattern that fights the hero.
Dark, dramatic or photographic environments; scenes stay bright and cartoon-clean.
Background figures, people, animals or a crowd of secondary props.
A hard-edged black outline or a busy mid-ground between hero and backdrop.
generator_wording: One centered hero filling most of a square card. Backdrop is a bright, smooth gradient with huge quiet shapes: soft rings, stripes, or faint tone-on-tone icons. Simple ground plane with a soft shadow. Environments, if any, are a few large cartoon shapes with at most two or three object-related props. No faces, sparkles or text.
